QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says only MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is off by default. It never says MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD, the second threading macro, is also undefined in the shipped config, so it doesn't state that both macros are left undefined.
